newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Metal Exchange closes for HK handover.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Metal Exchange closes for HK handover.

text.p: The Shanghai Metal Exchange will close next Monday and Tuesday to celebrate Hong Kong's handover to Chinese rule at midnight on Monday, an exchange official said on Friday.
Trading would resume on Wednesday, the official said.

The most actively traded October 1997 contract ended Friday at 22,160 yuan ($2,673) per tonne, losing 90 yuan. It opened at 22,230 yuan, hitting an intraday high of 22,280 and a low of 22,060 yuan per tonne.
